name: Neon Arrows
description: A lattice of red arrow hazards surrounds fourteen short cyan walls. Red ground is lethal until captured; cyan walls block movement and cannot close a cut. Four yellow bouncers roam the field while four cyan patrols travel the safe perimeter. Start at bottom center, weave between the arrows, and reconnect to safe ground to reveal 75%.
